caption: A woman in a white shirt sits at a table against a textured white wall, a dark object fixed at the upper right. On the table a white bottle labeled ALCOHOL 96% stands untouched at the left, while before her a clear glass holds a yellowish liquid and a slanted stick. In her right hand she grips a plastic bottle with an open red flip-top cap, first raised and motion-blurred near her shoulder as her left hand is held up. She lowers and tilts the red-capped bottle toward the glass, bringing her left hand down to steady it as a thin stream of pale liquid then runs from the mouth into the glass. The tilt is held steady while the pour continues to the last frame, the alcohol bottle, glass, and stick remaining fixed within an unmoving camera view.
